title: Putting Plastic on a Pedestal: Experimental methods of plastic waste reduction for 3D printing
description: A defensive publication describing hollow-tower pedestal supports with wide filleted lobe heads, a four-layer interface cap rewritten into the G-code, and wall-to-wall tether supports with a simulated span limit, implemented as the Cura plug-in Hybrid Supports. Physically untested: all results are from Cura 5.13 slices and a sag simulation.
